Inline comments:
Review comments at @bindings/python/src/py_store/quad_store.rs:
- Around line 85-97: In the graph-selection logic in `query_rdflib`, excluded
rows can remove a projected triple after a selected row has inserted it.
Separate the `surface_of` processing into two passes: remove all excluded rows
first, then insert projections for included rows under the existing scope
conditions. Add a regression test for a named `rdf:reifies` quad and default
reifier row that project to the same triple when querying context `g`.

Review comments at @crates/sparql-eval/src/property_fn_eval.rs:
- Around line 2153-2165: Update the iterative walk’s GraphPattern::Apply
handling to reject on-demand reads for both optional and non-optional policies,
matching the recursive reference’s contextual-application behavior. Add a
dedicated Resume variant that preserves the existing optional-versus-conjunction
column handling and provenance merge, but returns not_one_call for the Apply
result instead of routing non-optional applications through Resume::Join.

Review comments at @crates/sparql-eval/src/property_fn_plan.rs:
- Around line 2114-2124: Update the non-optional Apply handling in collect_bound
so the right operand receives a context widened with each policy.inputs input
whose driver is bound by the left operand or outer context. Preserve the
existing optional Apply behavior.

Review comments at @crates/sparql-eval/src/service_endpoints.rs:
- Around line 657-662: Update the GraphPattern::Apply summary and recursive
reference paths in ServedIndex to follow classify’s policy-sensitive handling:
when policy.optional is present, keep right-operand endpoint uses indirect
rather than merging them as direct; preserve direct handling when it is absent.

After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local
review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr
